n: Red Roof Inn Columbia East - Ft Jackson
pets: With friendly service and convenient amenities, our hotel makes every stay simple and stress-free. Our hotel is 100% smoke-free. Guests can expect a comfortable stay with the basics you need, including free Verified Wi-Fi, a free expanded cable package featuring HBO, and complimentary coffee in the lobby. We are proud to be a pet-friendly hotel, so your four-legged companion is always welcome.
Up to 2 pets allowed. First pet stays free. Second pet $15 per night.
